title.narrative: European Moldova: embracing the path to EU integration

description.narrative: The objective of this project is to build upon the intensive work conducted by the WatchDog.MD Community, focusing on monitoring and analyzing the informational landscape in Moldova, as well as implementing a robust communication campaign. The overarching goal of the campaign is to enhance societal resilience against Kremlin-driven disinformation regarding the European Union, its member states, and Moldova's Western partners.
